title: Tell me you're a Virgo without telling me
old_caption: Labels the snacks. Edits one text nine times. Already wrote down your allergies and your window seat. Tell me you're a Virgo without telling me. Who's yours?

title: Aquarius building a weird machine
old_caption: Aquarius built something: forty gears, a coil, a crane arm, worrying noises. Virgo watched with one eyebrow up. Wait for it. It does exactly one thing. Who builds you weird gifts?

title: Capricorn's packed calendar… one block reads free time with you
old_caption: Capricorn's calendar: meeting, emails, a meeting about the meeting, lunch at the desk. And one taped-shut block marked PRIVATE. Wait for it. Who would book you first?

title: Leo clearing their throat for a big speech
old_caption: Leo has a speech. A spotlight, three throat clears, and a growing stack of index cards. Sag braces for impact. Tonight's topic? Sag. Obviously. Who would give a speech about you?

title: Scorpio staring across the café
old_caption: Scorpio stared across the cafe for five unblinking minutes and started taking notes. Gemini started sweating. Wait for it. Which sign notices everything?

title: Taurus slowly making a sandwich… gives away the bigger half
old_caption: Eleven layers, more cheese, a cut line nowhere near the middle, and Cancer starving the whole time. Then Taurus hands over the big half. Worth the wait?

title: Describe the perfect first date
old_caption: Aries made it a race, Capricorn brought a quarterly budget review, and Taurus served dinner nine times. Wrong answers only. What's your worst perfect first date?

title: Name a dealbreaker
old_caption: Name a dealbreaker, wrong answers only. Leo: they've never heard of me. Virgo: they fold towels in thirds. Libra: can I get back to you, three weeks later. What's your real one?

title: What's your love language?
old_caption: Taurus: fluent in snacks. Gemini: speaks English, Spanish and sarcasm. Scorpio: unblinking eye contact, and the date stares right back. Then Pisces, sniffling, asks for all five. What's your wrong answer?

title: How do you know it's love?
old_caption: Gemini's thumbs got tired, Scorpio ran a vibe audit, and Aquarius received a memo from the moon. Then Pisces, sniffling, gave the real one. How do you know it's love?
